messages.subject: Is it possible the use arrows on keyboard to control the selection of row?
parts: I tried to show the DT in shinydashboard, and in the options of DT, I set the selection in "single" row only, and each row actually corresponds to one group of results (figures). I am thinking of using keyboard, like left and right arrow, to control the selected row in DT to move up or down, instead of using mouse to click the row in DT. Is there anyway to do it?
